book.name: ʻIsaia
book.title: KO E TOHI ʻAE PALŌFITA KO ʻISAIA

content.text: Koeʻuhi ko Saione ʻe ʻikai te u fakalongo pe,
pea koeʻuhi ko Selūsalema ʻe ʻikai te u mālōlō,
kaeʻoua ke ulo atu ʻa ʻene māʻoniʻoni ʻo hangē ko e maama lahi,
pea mo ʻene fakamoʻui ʻo hangē ko e maama ʻoku ulo.
Pea ʻe mamata ʻae ngaahi Senitaile ki hoʻo māʻoniʻoni,
mo e ngaahi tuʻi kotoa pē ki ho nāunau;
pea ʻe ui ʻaki koe ʻae hingoa foʻou,
ʻaia ʻe fakahā ʻe he folofola ʻa Sihova.
Pea te ke hoko foki ko e tatā ʻoe nāunau ʻi he nima ʻo Sihova,
mo e pale fakatuʻi ʻi he nima ʻo ho ʻOtua,
‌ʻE ʻikai toe ui koe “ko e Liʻaki;”
pea ʻe ʻikai toe ui ho fonua “ko e Lala:”
ka e ui koe “ko Hefisipa,”
mo ho fonua “ko Piula:”
he ʻoku fiefia ʻa Sihova ʻiate koe,
pea ʻe fai ʻae taʻane ʻi ho fonua.
Hangē ʻoku mali ʻae talavou mo e tāupoʻou,
ʻe pehē ʻae mali ho ngaahi foha mo koe:
pea hangē ʻoku fiefia ʻae tangata taʻane ʻi he taʻahine,
ʻe pehē ʻae fiefia ʻa ho ʻOtua ʻiate koe.
Kuo u fekau ʻae kau tangata leʻo ki ho ngaahi ʻā, ʻE Selūsalema,
pea ʻe ʻikai te nau fakalongo pē ʻi he ʻaho pe ʻi he pō;
ko kimoutolu ʻoku fakahā ʻa Sihova, ʻoua ʻe fakalongo pe,
Pea ʻoua naʻa tuku kiate ia ha fiemālie,
kaeʻoua ke fokotuʻumaʻu ʻe ia ʻa Selūsalema, pea ke ne ngaohi ia ko e ongoongolelei ʻi māmani.
Kuo fuakava ʻe Sihova ʻi hono nima toʻomataʻu,
pea ʻi he nima ʻo hono mālohi,
“Ko e moʻoni ʻe ʻikai te u toe foaki hoʻo uite ko e meʻakai ki ho ngaahi fili;
pea ʻe ʻikai inu ʻe he ngaahi foha ʻoe muli ʻi hoʻo uaine, ʻaia kuo ke ngāue ke maʻu:
Ka ko kinautolu kuo tānaki ia te nau kai ia, pea fakamālō kia Sihova;
pea ko kinautolu kuo ʻomi fakataha ia te nau inu ia ʻi he ngaahi loto ʻā ʻo hoku māʻoniʻoni.
Hū atu, hū atu ʻi he ngaahi matapā;
teuteu ʻae hala ʻoe kakai;
fokotuʻu hake, fokotuʻu hake ʻae hala māʻolunga;
tānaki mei ai ʻae ngaahi maka;
fokotuʻu ʻae fuka maʻa ʻe kakai.
Vakai, kuo folofola ʻa Sihova ʻo aʻu ki he ngataʻanga ʻo māmani,
“Mou pehē ki he ʻofefine ʻo Saione,
‘Vakai, ʻoku haʻu hoʻo fakamoʻui;
vakai, ʻoku ʻiate ia hono totongi,
pea ʻi hono ʻao ʻa ʻene ngāue.’”
Pea te nau ui ʻakinautolu, “Ko e kakai māʻoniʻoni,
Ko e kakai kuo huhuʻi ʻe Sihova:”
pea ʻe ui koe, “Ko e ʻofeina,
Ko e kolo taʻeliʻaki.”
